article.title: Influ2讓B2B團隊按聯絡人意向訊號發掘新企業客戶
article.title_en: Influ2 adds contact-level intent to B2B account discovery
article.summary: 新功能Audienscope Discover以個別聯絡人訊號找出其所屬企業，供行銷及銷售團隊排序。
article.summary_en: Audienscope Discover uses signals from individual contacts to surface their companies for marketing and sales prioritisation.
highlights: 企業可來自現有CRM名單以外。
Influ2稱工具會隨新訊號持續調整企業排序。
highlights_en: The surfaced companies can be outside the existing CRM list.
Influ2 says rankings update as new signals appear.
article.why: B2B團隊可在擴充目標名單時，同時評估聯絡人角色和企業需求。
article.why_en: B2B teams can assess company fit and contact roles while expanding target lists.
article.next_step: 抽查新增企業是否符合目標客群，再由銷售核對聯絡人角色及訊號來源。
article.next_step_en: Sample new accounts and have sales check contact roles and signal sources.
article.detail: 以目標企業為單位的行銷通常先確定公司名單，再找相關聯絡人。Influ2這項功能把聯絡人的行為訊號用在前一步，協助發掘名單之外的企業。訊號可用於決定跟進順序，仍需確認企業是否適合、聯絡人有否參與採購，以及所用資料在目標市場的適用範圍。逐項抽查可避免只按總分分配銷售時間。
article.detail_en: Account-based marketing often starts with companies and then identifies relevant people. Influ2 uses individual signals earlier to find additional accounts. Teams still need to check company fit, buying roles and data coverage in the markets they intend to target. Sampling keeps the score from becoming the sole basis for sales follow-up.
